# Checkpoint

Task: implement `ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade` (`-U`) with constraint-aware, idempotent dependency upgrades and opt-in prerelease handling.

Implemented:
- Added the collection install CLI option and passed its default-false value into `install_collections`.
- Upgrade resolution reevaluates explicitly requested collections, prefers newest compatible versions for those roots, and preserves installed transitive dependencies when they still satisfy constraints. A selected version already installed is skipped.
- Resolver carries upgrade intent and continues applying version constraints. `--no-deps` still disables dependency traversal. The existing explicit prerelease pin behavior remains, while `--pre` allows prereleases for floating/range selection.
- Added integration coverage in `test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml` for stable upgrades, idempotency, prereleases, and requirements files; included it from the integration target main task.

diff --git a/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml b/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3247518
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+---
+- name: create isolated collection path for upgrade tests - {{ test_name }}
+  file:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+    state: directory
+
+- name: install an older collection version before upgrade - {{ test_name }}
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:0.0.1
+    -s '{{ test_name }}' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+    {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+
+- name: upgrade collection to latest stable version - {{ test_name }}
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1 -U
+    -s '{{ test_name }}' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+    {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_collection
+
+- name: read upgraded collection manifest - {{ test_name }}
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: upgrade_manifest
+
+- name: assert upgrade selected the latest stable version - {{ test_name }}
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "(upgrade_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.9'"
+    - "'Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.0.9'' to' in upgrade_collection.stdout"
+
+- name: repeat upgrade without reinstalling an up-to-date collection - {{ test_name }}
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1 --upgrade
+    -s '{{ test_name }}' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+    {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_collection_again
+
+- name: assert repeat upgrade is idempotent - {{ test_name }}
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Installing ' not in upgrade_collection_again.stdout"
+
+- name: upgrade to a pre-release only when --pre is given - {{ test_name }}
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade --pre namespace1.name1
+    -s '{{ test_name }}' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+    {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_prerelease
+
+- name: read pre-release collection manifest - {{ test_name }}
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: prerelease_manifest
+
+- name: assert --pre allows upgrading to the latest pre-release - {{ test_name }}
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "(prerelease_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.1.0-beta.1'"
+    - "'Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.1.0-beta.1'' to' in upgrade_prerelease.stdout"
+
+- name: write requirements file with an older collection pin - {{ test_name }}
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+        - name: namespace1.name1
+          version: '>=0.0.1,<2.0.0'
+
+- name: apply upgrade semantics to a requirements file - {{ test_name }}
+  command: >-
+    ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml'
+    -s '{{ test_name }}' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+    {{ galaxy_verbosity }}
+  register: upgrade_requirements
+
+- name: read requirements file upgraded manifest - {{ test_name }}
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: requirements_upgrade_manifest
+
+- name: assert requirements file upgraded the requested collection - {{ test_name }}
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "(requirements_upgrade_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.9'"
+
+- name: remove upgrade test collections - {{ test_name }}
+  file:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
+    state: absent
